## README

# sarah-email-triage-bot

Email triage bot for Sarah's Brand OS — monitors Gmail, classifies inbound emails with GPT-4o, applies labels, and saves AI-drafted replies. Built for a creator/copywriter who runs courses, a Skool community, premium services, and a Flowdesk newsletter.

## How it works

1. Gmail pushes new-message notifications to Google Cloud Pub/Sub
2. Bot fetches each new email via Gmail History API
3. GPT-4o classifies intent, urgency, sentiment, and business value
4. Bot applies Gmail labels (e.g. `Triage/Sales Lead`) and saves a draft reply
5. All data (contacts, threads, classifications, drafts, events) is stored in Supabase

## Quick start (60 seconds)

```bash
# 1. Install deps
npm install

# 2. Copy and fill in credentials
cp .env.example .env

# 3. One-time OAuth2 setup (opens browser)
npm run auth

# 4. Sync Gmail label registry to Supabase
npm run sync-labels

# 5. Start in development mode (hot reload)
npm run dev

# OR build and run for production
npm run build && npm start
```

## Required environment variables

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` | Google OAuth2 client ID |
| `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` | Google OAuth2 client secret |
| `GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI` | OAuth callback URL (default: `http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/google`) |
| `GCP_PROJECT_ID` | Google Cloud project ID for Pub/Sub |
| `PUBSUB_TOPIC` | Pub/Sub topic name (e.g. `gmail-notifications`) |
| `PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION` | Pub/Sub subscription name (e.g. `gmail-notifications-sub`) |
| `SUPABASE_URL` | Supabase project URL |
| `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | Supabase service role key |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | OpenAI API key (uses GPT-4o) |

## Scripts

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `npm run dev` | Run with hot reload (tsx watch) |
| `npm start` | Run compiled build |
| `npm run build` | Compile TypeScript to `dist/` |
| `npm run auth` | OAuth2 authorization flow (generates `token.json`) |
| `npm run sync-labels` | Fetch Gmail labels and sync to Supabase |
| `npm test` | Run vitest suite |

## Email classification

GPT-4o classifies each email into one of 12 intents: `sales_inquiry`, `premium_lead`, `support_request`, `billing_issue`, `partnership`, `skool_member_question`, `flowdesk_reply`, `internal_ops`, `spam`, `newsletter_reply`, `general`, `unknown`.

Each classification also includes urgency, sentiment, business value, confidence score, key entities, extracted questions, action items, and a draft reply.

## GCP Pub/Sub setup

Gmail watches expire every 7 days. The bot auto-renews every 6 days while running. For initial setup:

```bash
# Create topic and subscription (run once)
bash scripts/gcp-setup.sh
```

## Known limitations

- Requires live GCP Pub/Sub + Gmail credentials — cannot run offline
- `route_to` integrations (Honeybook, ClickUp, Flowdesk) classify intent but do not yet make outbound API calls
- `auto_sendable` flag is computed but replies always require human approval before sending
- Gmail watch requires the process to stay alive for auto-renewal; deploy as a persistent service
